title: Suggesting a campaign
prompt: If you want to suggest a new advertising campaign, what should you say?
hint: Start with 'I suggest we' and include 'launch a new advertising campaign'.
sample: I suggest we launch a new advertising campaign.

ja.prompt: 新しい広告キャンペーンを提案したいとき、何と言いますか？
ja.hint: 「I suggest we...」で始めて、「launch a new advertising campaign」を入れてください。
ja.sample: I suggest we launch a new advertising campaign.

local.prompt: 你想提出新的廣告活動，可以怎麼說？
local.hint: 以「I suggest we」開頭，並說出「launch a new advertising campaign」。
